statutes.act: Read With Section 34 Of The Indian Penal Code

facts: The incident in question was alleged to have taken place on 22.01.2002.

Mohan Gavane (hereinafter referred to as the 'deceased') along with his family members including his sons Narsing (PW-5), Devising (PW-6) and his wife Chandrabhaga (PW-9) was staying on the bank of river by erecting a hut.
The accused claiming to be the owners of the said land used to take objection to the deceased and his family members and were giving threat to kill in case they cultivate that alluvial land.
On the day of incident, Narsing (PW-5) had gone to the river to catch fish.
His brother Devising (PW-6) had gone in the village on a cycle to fetch fertiliser.
Their mother Chandrabhaga (PW-9) along with her daughter-in-law was looking after their watermelon crop and were busy in cutting grass.
Deceased Mohan was taking his cattle towards the well.
issues: What is the legal significance of the Fourth Exception of Section 300, IPC?
Can a case be brought under this exception if there is no premeditation and the fight is sudden?
petitioner_arguments: The evidence of the so called eye witnesses clearly show that they are exaggerated, full of holes and do not depict a correct position of the factual scenario.
The role of accused Nos. 2 and 3 was not established.

In any event, the occurrence took place because of the fact that the deceased had encroached on the land of the accused-appellant and in spite of being told not to encroach upon his land, he repeatedly came upon the land and created disturbances.
A single blow was given and Section 302 IPC was ruled out.
respondent_arguments: The Fourth Exception of Section 300, IPC covers acts done in a sudden fight.
The said exception deals with a case of prosecution not covered by the first exception, after which its place would have been more appropriate.
There is provocation in Exception 4 as in Exception 1; but the injury done is not the direct consequence of that provocation.
court_reasoning: The assault undisputedly was given on the course of the sudden quarrel, without pre-mutation and without the accused taking any undue advantage.
To bring a case within Exception 4 all the ingredients mentioned in it must be found.
It is to be noted that the 'fight' occurring in Exception 4 to Section 300, IPC is not defined in the IPC.
A fight is a combat between two and more persons whether with or without weapons.
holding: The appeal is allowed to the aforesaid extent. Custodial sentence of 10 years would suffice.
